Dear @everyone,

Thank you so much from the bottom of our hearts for your help! We have compiled the translation contributions we've received so far; the translations have been updated in game as of the V2.5.3 update. (08/06/2026)

The list of Volunteers in our in-game Special Thanks page will also be updated according to this list. Please confirm if we have logged your name (the name you want us to credit you by) and contribution content correctly! If there is any mistake, please let me know and we will fix it asap.

⭐ New Awakener — Key Terminology Translation ⭐
We will update the current MTL with terms you've translated during the next hotfix update. Thank you so much for your help! 
● ID：Adelle, Cha, Rosemary, Yunita    
● TH：darkerkuro, Shiraori    
● JP：Alza        
● RU：Haps, Chie, Riddle
● VN：Anicillia
● KR: 성우학과대학생의현실살이, Lasha, FongDue, ASTAR, 량, Ploara.V.C, Hierarch, Lica, 때까치, KD, 별이, 외곽, Francis, SJ88, Cullet, Bahisa, Yeon — Optimization (Terminology)


If we've missed anyone or logged anything incorrectly, just let us know and we'll fix it right away. Thank you all again! 💙
